agent_priors_used: Agent prior: cached and compiled work decays; maintenance/revalidation cost, not replay speed, usually decides whether work compression pays (consistent with the P2-REPLAY-COST matched-task guard).

Agent prior: an abstention gate is only trustworthy when false-accept and coverage are calibrated on a disjoint split with meaningful abstention mass; a signal that abstains on two examples cannot certify unknown precision.
Agent prior: repeated same-cause pre-freeze failures (design-review or freeze-stage) are a prerequisite/control-plane defect to repair once, not a scientific negative to rediscover across lanes.

Agent prior: a benchmark whose comparator arms sit at a correctness ceiling cannot discriminate; non-ceiling dynamic range and memoryful comparators are prerequisites before any arm-vs-arm cost claim.
Agent prior: single-vantage and single-substrate results are plausibly vantage-specific, but a generalization test is only worth paying for when its constructibility is certified pre-freeze.
Agent prior: lane continuity is path-dependent and local; idle/tunnel-flagged lanes need an explicit continue/park decision rather than inertia.

Agent prior: a product that abstains safely on out-of-grammar inputs is shippable; a false-accept on out-of-grammar inputs is a safety defect that must be fixed before external agents consume the carrier.

allocation.rationale: Product is idle after discharging readiness condition (1). The packet's only flagged unresolved property (result.json#unresolved) is whether the carrier's conservative abstention is safe. This is decision-changing and Product-local: zero false accepts on a materially varied/out-of-grammar bank certifies the safety boundary of the shipped UNKNOWN-preferring path and licenses external consumption; any false accept is a defect that must be fixed in resolve() before the adapter loop may consume the carrier. It is cheap (no model key, no browser, deterministic payload bank), non-externally-gated (explicitly does not require Runtime/Intel), and is the smallest decisive batch on the shipped bytes. It does NOT fund the four-arm benchmark: readiness condition (2) (memoryful task bank) and (3) (capable endpoint) remain open, so C-LLM-INHERIT/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY/C-PRODUCT-ECON execution stays unfunded this cycle.

Cognitive resets were performed for every lane, including tunnel-flagged Physics (8/10 C-WEB-DYNAMICS, 5 same-failures) and Frontier (5/10 C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY). Frontier, Graph, Physics and Runtime all carry pre-freeze design-stage failures recorded within minutes of each other under the same control_revision (905755fa...): Frontier model_design+review succeeded but the deterministic freeze step exited 1 without producing freeze.json; Physics' independent design review rejected substantively 10+ times; Runtime failed at OpenCode install (retryable=true). This is a shared control-plane/design-freeze defect signal, not scientific evidence; it should be repaired once (Runtime/ops) instead of being re-interpreted as per-lane invalids. Marginal-yield read of the 60-packet window (revise_or_invalid 0.45, 14 MEASUREMENT_INVALID) reinforces: do not re-issue near-duplicate pre-freeze attempts for the same unsatisfiable certificate. Starved claim C-DELTA-REPAIR (0 recent) is noted but its next gate requires a distributed health-gated real-LLM fixture (infrastructure-bound); it is not allocated this cycle rather than being force-fed an underpowered local rerun. Keeping one idle lane none: Product is reactivated this cycle with the cheap, decisive, non-externally-gated carrier-boundary question.
